scientific_integrity: Universal analytic argument using three-tree optimal transport and Lipschitz polytope duality. Finite direction samples are auxiliary only.
scientific_limitations: Does not claim a global triangulation theorem or optimality among nonlinear interpolants; equivalent less-indexed prior art remains possible.
scientific_scope: Sharp local affine barycentric interpolation into real Lipschitz-free p-spaces of Euclidean triangle vertices for 0<p<=1.
title: The sharp Euclidean triangle constant for barycentric Lipschitz-free \(p\)-interpolation
